item.title: UK warship HMS Dragon departs for eastern Mediterranean
item.summary: The Type 45 destroyer's main role will be protecting RAF Akrotiri, which was hit with an Iranian-made drone.

item.title: War expands to central Beirut as Israeli strike kills Iranians in luxury hotel
item.summary: Israel's military says it targeted Quds Force operatives after a return to war with Lebanon's Hezbollah movement, but Iran says they were diplomats.

item.title: Air strikes cause black rain and 'unprecedented' pollution in Tehran, scientists say
item.summary: Air strikes have damaged at least four oil facilities since US-Israeli attacks on Iran began last month.

item.summary: Iranians in Tehran and Karaj tell the BBC they are exhausted and struggling to sleep after 10 days of Israeli and US attacks.

item.title: Nottingham triple killer assaulted husband and wife weeks before attacks, inquiry told
item.summary: Valdo Calocane attacked two colleagues weeks before he killed three people in Nottingham.

item.title: Millions of PlayStation players charged unfair download fees, court hears
item.summary: The console maker is accused of charging fans "excessive" fees to obtain software from its official store.

item.title: Oil and gas prices fall after Trump says war is 'very complete'
item.summary: The US president's comments lead to a drop in crude costs and a rebound in shares.

item.summary: Parents were frightened by social posts that seemed to encourage violence at schools. But it was more complicated than it looked

item.title: Glasgow Central's main station to remain closed until next week after huge fire
item.summary: A huge fire destroyed a neighbouring building but Network Rail staff believe the station has not been seriously damaged.

item.title: Relaunched digital ID will make it easier to access services, minister says
item.summary: Darren Jones says the scheme - originally aimed at curbing illegal working - is now about improving services.
